name: ML-assisted AON upper-bound slack discovery
target: existing analytic upper K+1 minus exact K+1
training: seeded 80% of the exhaustive four-input universe plus sampled five-input costs 0 through 9
calibration: five-input cost 10; maximum dangerous residual (predicted slack minus true slack)
validation: five-input cost 12 upper-tail and random-reference challenge cohorts
four_input_audit: maximum dangerous residual over all 65536 functions
notes: No cost-11 or cost-12 exact target is used for fitting or calibration. The learned correction is statistical on prospective five-input tests and finite-domain certified only where exhaustively audited.
